I visited this groomer a few years ago and had an excellent experience, but the service has declined since then. I was recently admitted to hospital, so I couldn’t brush my Persian cat’s coat or take him to a groomer. This led to small knots under his front legs. My cat is very used to grooming—he actually enjoys it. He loves baths, is extremely docile, and is always calm during grooming. The only things he dislikes, understandably, are being locked in a cage and having a blow dryer aimed directly at his face. I made sure to explain all of this to the groomer beforehand.

Despite that, the groomer bathed him roughly. The bath itself was messy, and afterwards, even though I had specifically asked her not to, she put him in a cage and used the blow dryer at full force. This agitated him and frightened him so badly that he curled up in a corner. Once he was dried, instead of gently detangling the knots, she tugged at them harshly. When he started objecting, because he was being mishandled, she immediately took out a razor and shaved the knots, claiming it was the only option.

What made the experience worse was how she tried to blame my cat, calling him “aggressive”, which couldn’t be further from the truth. Her rough handling is what caused him to react, yet she showed no apology, no empathy, and no attempt to be gentle afterwards. Only later did I realise why she rushed through everything, she simply wanted to finish quickly so she could move on to her next appointment.

Speaking of appointments, getting one here is like winning a lottery. Even if you do manage to book a slot, there’s no guarantee you’ll actually receive the service. She cancels without notice, and you only find out when you reach the salon and see the shutters down or a helper tells you she isn’t available. There is absolutely no courtesy of informing clients beforehand.

The only reason I went back to this groomer was because of my earlier experience at her previous facility, which was genuinely good. Unfortunately, this new facility, and the service, has completely changed.
